# CE-1 — Kick-off call with sales head and accounts

Type: call notes · Date: 2026-10-01 · File: inputs/CE-1-kick-off-call-with-sales-head.md

---

Kick-off call, 1 Oct 2026. Present: Meera (sales head), Joel (accounts), Neomenta consultant.

Meera: We sell imported floor and wall tiles to contractors and walk-in buyers from two showrooms (Kochi, Calicut).
Meera: Enquiries come by phone, WhatsApp and walk-in. We lose track of them; nobody follows up after a week.
Meera: Each sales exec should see only their own enquiries. I want to see all of them.
Meera: When an enquiry is serious we send a quotation. Quotations are made in Excel today and emailed as PDF.
Meera: Any discount above the usual needs my approval. Sometimes Joel also checks if the buyer has unpaid bills.
Joel: Invoices are raised in Tally. Quotations should not go to Tally until the buyer accepts.
Meera: We have 9 sales execs. Around 300 enquiries a month in season.
Meera: Staff should be trained before go-live; most use only WhatsApp on phones.
